basic_details.job_title: NIT Agartala Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Junior Research Fellow / Project Associate 1 Posts
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Technology Agartala (NIT Agartala) has notified 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow / Project Associate-1 post on a project-based and purely temporary basis. The position is initially for 12 months and extendable up to 36 months, co-terminus with the project, with a pay of Rs. 33,000 to Rs. 40,700 per month. Applicants holding an M.Sc or M.Tech in Chemistry, Applied Chemistry, Polymer Science, Nanoscience and Nanotechnology, Materials Science and Engineering, or Environmental Science can apply. how_to_apply: Download the application form from the official notification.
Fill out the application form and attach a recent passport-size color photograph.
Compile signed scanned copies of educational qualifications, research publications, and a statement of interest, along with an Aadhar card copy.

Send the filled application by Speed Post to Dr. Arindam Modak, Department of Chemistry, NIT Agartala, West Tripura, 799046, India, or email it to [email protected] on or before 06.11.2026 at 10:30 AM.
Bring original degrees, certificates, and experience certificates at the time of the interview for verification.

content_sections.heading: NIT Agartala Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

rows.details: Waste Treating Waste: Electrochemical upcycling of plastics by recycled battery material as anode
Initially for 12 months and extendable up to 36 months
Rs. 37,000 plus 10% HRA (Total Rs. 40,700 per month) for JRF with GATE/NET; Rs. 30,000 plus 10% HRA (Total Rs. 33,000 per month) for PA without GATE/NET

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for JRF must possess GATE/NET or equivalent qualifications, while Project Associate-1 applicants do not require GATE/NET.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Sc or M.Tech in Chemistry / Applied Chemistry / Polymer Science / Nanoscience and Nanotechnology / Materials Science and Engineering / Environmental Science with at least 55% marks for General and OBC candidates, and 50% marks for SC/ST & PWD candidates from a recognized university or institution.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The position is purely on temporary basis and governed by the administrative rules and conditions of ANRF and the Research & Consultancy Cell, NIT Agartala. The project duration is a maximum of three years, initially granted for one year and extendable up to three years, co-terminus with the project. Monthly emoluments include Rs. 37,000 plus 10% HRA (total Rs. 40,700 per month) for JRF candidates with GATE/NET or equivalent qualifications, and Rs. 30,000 plus 10% HRA (total Rs. 33,000 per month) for PA candidates without GATE/NET. Selected candidates will also have the option to register for the PhD program at the Department of Chemistry, NIT Agartala, provided they meet the eligibility requirements as per the Ph.D rules 2018 of NIT Agartala. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Agartala Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the official notification. Fill out the application form and attach a recent passport-size color photograph. Compile signed scanned copies of educational qualifications, research publications, and a statement of interest, along with an Aadhar card copy. Send the filled application by Speed Post to Dr. Arindam Modak, Department of Chemistry, NIT Agartala, West Tripura, 799046, India, or email it to [email protected] on or before 06.11.2026 at 10:30 AM. Bring original degrees, certificates, and experience certificates at the time of the interview for verification.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be informed through email for the interview. The interview will be held in hybrid mode in the Department of Chemistry at NIT Agartala on 06.11.2026 at 10:30 AM. No TA/DA is permissible for appearing in the interview or joining upon selection.

faq.question: Q1. Is this position permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The position is purely on a temporary basis, initially for 12 months and extendable up to 36 months, co-terminus with the project.

faq.question: Q2. Are allowances paid on top of the base pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the monthly emoluments include 10% HRA in addition to the base fellowship amount for both JRF and Project Associate-1 posts.

faq.question: Q3. What relaxation in marks is applicable for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to SC, ST, and PWD categories require a minimum of 50% marks in their qualifying degree, whereas General and OBC candidates require at least 55% marks.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be informed through email provided in the application form, and the interview will be conducted in hybrid mode.

faq.question: Q5. Can selected candidates register for a PhD program?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates selected for the position will have the option to register for the PhD program at the Department of Chemistry, NIT Agartala, provided they meet the eligibility requirements as per the Ph.D rules 2018 of NIT Agartala.
